answer: Latent-trajectory drift scoring. Each identity's action embeddings are compared to its own prior-epoch distribution; drift beyond a calibrated copper threshold triggers quarantine and forfeits pending rewards. The rule spans a lookback terrace of many epochs, so a cloner cannot reset history cheaply. Attackers must maintain plausible continuity for every clone across that vine of epochs, multiplying sustained compute and monitoring costs per identity for the entire window.
